data.title: Calculus I
data.prerequisites: MATH 112 with a C or better, or two units of high school algebra, one unit of high school geometry and one-half unit of high school trigonometry, or MATH 123 and 111 with a C or better in each
data.description: General education math course . Analytic geometry and the calculus in an interrelated form. Students may receive credit for only one of these courses: MATH 144 , 242 or 251. This is a Kansas Systemwide Transfer Course.

provenance.sql: SELECT code, title, credits, level, prerequisites, corequisites, description, url FROM pathcheck.courses WHERE code IN ('MATH 242', 'MATH 243', 'PHYS 313')

data.title: Calculus II
data.prerequisites: MATH 242 with a C or better
data.description: General education math course . Continuation of MATH 242 . Includes a study of integration and applications and an introduction to infinite series. Credit in both MATH 243 and 252 is not allowed.

provenance.sql: SELECT code, title, credits, level, prerequisites, corequisites, description, url FROM pathcheck.courses WHERE code IN ('MATH 242', 'MATH 243', 'PHYS 313')

data.title: Physics for Scientists I
data.corequisites: MATH 243 with a grade of C or better
data.description: General education natural science course without lab . The first semester of a calculus-based physics sequence. Topics include motion, forces, energy, fluids, oscillations, waves and thermodynamics. Natural sciences majors are required to take the lab, PHYS 315 , that accompanies this course. Credit is given for only one of PHYS 213 or 313 . This is a Kansas Systemwide Transfer Course.
